rows.grounds: locative plural of sahasra, expressing location within thousands
locative plural of compound yoni-yantra, denoting devices or realms of birth
past passive participle of root pīḍ, describing beings subjected to suffering

items.question: What is the extent of torment endured within the mechanisms of birth?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
These thousands are womb-mechanisms or birth-realms.
Beings are tormented within these realms.
items.inference: Beings undergo torment across the vast expanse of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
